description: This Java class defines ClobDatatypeStorage, which is used to store a potentially-long String value for CLOB-based custom datatypes within the OpenMRS project. It extends BaseOpenmrsObject, includes fields for id and value, and provides getter/setter methods. It is part of the org.openmrs.api.db package and is annotated as @Audited for change tracking.

classes.name: ClobDatatypeStorage
classes.description: Java class for storing large String data in custom data types within OpenMRS.

methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this storage object.
